structure: A damaged uptrend in transition — the Daily has printed lower highs ($7.34 → $6.7 → $6.1) against a horizontal, repeatedly-tested floor at $4.77–4.98.
Price rejected the $6.1 range high and has ground back to $5.13, sitting in the lower half and pressing toward the floor.
market_structure.volatility_note: The wide $4.8–6.1 swings have contracted into a tight $5.03–5.15 base just above support — energy coiling toward a resolution.
market_structure.bias_note: Lower highs, price below the 4H EMA ($5.22) and PR Average ($5.97), and heavily negative CVD all tilt down; the bias only confirms on a break of $4.80, the one counter being the strong multi-tested floor.

intermarket.note: INJ is tracking BTC at COR +0.74 (Moderate) — a BTC bounce can defend the $4.80 floor and stall the breakdown, while continued BTC weakness pressures the floor toward a break.

pattern_candidates.name: Descending Triangle
pattern_candidates.summary: Lower highs compressing into a strong floor with CVD and OI behind them. A 4H close below $4.80 opens a measured move toward $3.7; until then it's compression and the floor can bounce.

zone.subtitle: On a 4H close below the floor

stop.note: A reclaim back inside the range means the breakdown failed and rotation resumes.

t1.note: The late-April consolidation shelf — first downside pocket.

t2.note: Toward the triangle's measured move (range height ~$1.3 off $4.80) — the objective of a confirmed breakdown.

entry.tools: Predictive Ranges (4H) · horizontal S/R · equal-lows liquidity · CVD · Open Interest

evidence: Daily lower highs ($7.34 → $6.7 → $6.1) pressing a fixed $4.77–4.98 floor — the textbook descending triangle, sellers progressively defending lower prices.
Price below the 4H EMA ($5.22) and PR Average ($5.97), grinding toward PR Lower-2 ($4.80) — momentum sits with sellers into the apex.
CVD heavily negative (~−2.6M taker flow while price is flat) — distribution, not accumulation, behind the drift.
OI built +3.1% over 4 days as price fell — new shorts pressing, not short-covering; conviction behind the decline.
missing: The floor ($4.80) hasn't broken — until a 4H close below it, this is compression, not a triggered breakdown.
$4.77–4.98 has held ~4–5 times — a strong floor that can bounce before it breaks.

warnings: Floor unbroken — pending a 4H close below $4.80

pattern_candidates.name: Equal Low Sweep
pattern_candidates.qualifier: conditional — sweep + reclaim of the floor
pattern_candidates.summary: The bullish counter — buy a sweep-and-reclaim of the $4.8 floor toward the range mean. Good R:R if it triggers, but the base case is a break, not a hold.

zone.subtitle: On a 4H reclaim back above the swept floor

stop.note: Acceptance below the swept low = genuine breakdown, thesis dead.

t1.note: PR Lower-1 / range mid — first pivot back toward the mean.

t2.note: PR Average / range mean — full rotation back into the range.

entry.tools: Predictive Ranges (4H) · equal-lows liquidity · horizontal S/R · CVD (watch for a positive shift)

evidence: The $4.77–4.98 equal lows are obvious liquidity — a sweep below then reclaim would trap breakdown sellers at a floor defended ~4–5 times.
A reclaim back into the range targets the mean (PR Average $5.97) — strong R:R from a defined floor.
missing: Hasn't swept or reclaimed — purely conditional.
CVD heavily negative + OI building argue the floor is more likely to break than reverse — this fights the flow.

warnings: Counter to the bearish CVD/OI flow

pattern_candidates.name: Bear Flag
pattern_candidates.summary: The near-term leg into the floor, but with support right below there's nothing to trade here on its own.

stop.note: Reclaim above the flag = the continuation leg failed.

t1.note: The $4.80 floor — the move is already nearly there.

t2.note: Interim shelf if the floor breaks with it.

evidence: The tight $5.03–5.15 consolidation just above the floor is a low-level bear flag — a pause before the next push at $4.80.
missing: Almost no room to the floor — the move is already at support.
Duplicates the descending-triangle thesis at a faster timeframe; little fresh edge.

warnings: Better expressed as the triangle break
